summary: See every Cobalt UI component on the device in one reference app.
release_notes: Every reference panel is measured against the screen it is drawn on, so the components gallery fits at all nine text sizes instead of running off the bottom.
user: Somebody building or checking a Cobalt app.
job: See every Cobalt UI component on the device in one reference app.
offline: The component reference works without the network; the live network demo does not.
non_goals: It is not a store or a launcher.
It does not change device settings.
